translation_origin: authored in English for this build

clips.come_closer: Bring the phone closer to the leaf.
clips.low_light: It is too dark. Please move to better light.
clips.no_leaf: Show one leaf in the middle of the screen.
clips.captured: Photo taken. Checking the leaf now.
clips.cannot_tell: I cannot tell from this photo. Please try again in good light, or visit the nearest agriculture office.
clips.not_a_leaf: This does not look like a plant leaf.
clips.unsupported_crop: This leaf looks different from the crops the system knows.
clips.sure_high: The system is fairly sure about this.
clips.uncertain_intro: The system is not sure. It may be:
clips.uncertain_caution: Because the result is not certain, please confirm before you spray or buy anything.
clips.ask_questions: Please answer a few questions by tapping yes or no.
clips.no_advice_found: Reliable advice for this was not found in the system.
clips.visit_office: Please show this leaf at the nearest agriculture office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
clips.seek_expert: If the problem spreads or you are unsure, ask at the agriculture office.
clips.where_help: Tap the map button to see help near you.
clips.stock_disclaimer: A shop in this list may not have the product you need.
clips.location_consent: To find help near you, the app needs your location one time. It is not saved. Tap yes to allow, or no to choose your district.
clips.no_shops_found: No shops were found nearby. Here is the nearest agriculture office.
clips.camera_denied: The camera is not available. Tap the picture button to choose a photo.
clips.try_again: Tap start to check another leaf.
clips.network_error: The internet connection failed. Please try again.
clips.offline_queued: You are offline. The photo is saved and will be checked fully when the internet returns.
clips.offline_result: This is a quick check on the phone. A full check will run when you are online.
